title: Finite separable field extensions and finite continuous G-sets
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], and G = Gal(K^sep/K) with its Krull topology. For every finite separable extension L/K (finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]), the set Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L) is a finite transitive discrete continuous G-set. For every K-embedding sigma: L \to K^sep, the stabilizer of the corresponding point is Gal(K^sep/sigma(L)). Conversely, every finite transitive discrete continuous G-set is isomorphic to one of this form. Moreover, for finite separable extensions L/K and L'/K, the map Hom_K(Spec L, Spec L') \to Hom_G(Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L), Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L')) induced by precomposition with geometric points is a bijection.

proof.text: For finite separable L/K, K-embeddings L\to K^sep correspond contravariantly to geometric points of Spec L. The embedding set is nonempty by [lem-exc-etale-embedding-extension-sepclosed] applied with E=L, F=K, intermediate field K, and f the inclusion K\to K^sep: every element of L is algebraic over K and its minimal polynomial is separable, hence splits in the separably closed K^sep. It is finite elementarily: choose a K-basis a_1,\ldots,a_n of L; an embedding is determined by the images of the a_i, and each image is one of finitely many roots in K^sep of the minimal polynomial of a_i. The extension K^sep/K is Galois: it is separable algebraic by [def-pd-separable-closure], and it is normal because every separable minimal polynomial over K splits in the separably closed K^sep. Given two embeddings sigma and tau, the map tau\circ sigma^{-1}:sigma(L)\to tau(L) extends by [lem-exc-etale-embedding-extension-sepclosed] to a K-algebra endomorphism phi:K^sep\to K^sep; its hypotheses hold because K^sep is algebraic over K and the relevant separable minimal polynomials split there. This endomorphism is bijective by [lem-exc-etale-algebraic-endomorphism-bijective], hence is an element of G, proving transitivity. The stabilizer is {g | g\circ sigma=sigma}=Gal(K^sep/sigma(L)) by the definition of the fixing subgroup. This subgroup is open by [lem-exc-etale-finite-subextension-fixing-subgroup-open], since sigma(L) is finite-dimensional over K; therefore the action on the discrete embedding set is continuous.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite separable field component; Mathlib field-theory declarations supply the extension and openness facts

proof.text: Let S be a finite transitive discrete continuous G-set and H the stabilizer of a point. Continuity makes H open and the orbit map identifies S with G/H. By [lem-exc-etale-open-subgroup-fixed-field], L=(K^sep)^H is finite separable over K and H=Gal(K^sep/L). By step 1, the embedding G-set of L is transitive with stabilizer of the inclusion equal to Gal(K^sep/L)=H, so it is G-isomorphic to G/H and hence to S.

source.place: Tag 03QR, finite Galois correspondence discussion: orbit-stabilizer and fixed field

proof.text: For finite separable L/K and L'/K, injectivity of precomposition follows because field embeddings are injective and L has an embedding into K^sep (step 1). For surjectivity, let phi be equivariant and fix an embedding sigma_0:L\to K^sep; put tau=phi(sigma_0). Equivariance gives Gal(K^sep/sigma_0(L))\subseteq Gal(K^sep/tau(L')). Hence tau(L') lies in the fixed field of the fixing subgroup of sigma_0(L), which is sigma_0(L) by [lem-exc-etale-galois-fixed-field-subgroup], applicable since K^sep/K is Galois (step 1). Thus tau=sigma_0\circ psi for a unique K-map psi:L'\to L, and equivariance plus transitivity from step 1 gives phi=psi^* everywhere. Therefore the displayed Hom map is bijective.

lean.statement: theorem finite_separable_extension_galois_classification (K : Type u) (Ksep : Type v) [Field K] [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep] [IsSepClosure K Ksep] (L : Type w) (L' : Type w') [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra K L] [Algebra K L'] [FiniteDimensional K L] [FiniteDimensional K L'] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L'] : (Nonempty (L →ₐ[K] Ksep) ∧ Finite (L →ₐ[K] Ksep) ∧ (∀ σ τ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep, ∃ g : Gal(Ksep / K), g.toAlgHom.comp σ = τ) ∧ (∀ σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep, {g : Gal(Ksep / K) | g.toAlgHom.comp σ = σ} = (IntermediateField.map σ ⊤).fixingSubgroup) ∧ (∀ σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep, IsOpen {g : Gal(Ksep / K) | g.toAlgHom.comp σ = σ})) ∧ (∀ (Y : Type z) [Finite Y] [MulAction (Gal(Ksep / K)) Y], Nonempty Y → MulAction.IsPretransitive (Gal(Ksep / K)) Y → (∀ y : Y, IsOpen {g : Gal(Ksep / K) | g • y = y}) → ∃ E : IntermediateField K Ksep, FiniteDimensional K E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K E ∧ ∃ e : Y ≃ (E →ₐ[K] Ksep), ∀ (g : Gal(Ksep / K)) (y : Y), e (g • y) = g.toAlgHom.comp (e y)) ∧ Function.Bijective (fun (f : L' →ₐ[K] L) => (⟨fun (σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep) => σ.comp f, by intro g σ rfl⟩ : {φ : (L →ₐ[K] Ksep) → (L' →ₐ[K] Ksep) // ∀ (g : Gal(Ksep / K)) (σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep), φ (g.toAlgHom.comp σ) = g.toAlgHom.comp (φ σ)}))
